description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio CAP Initiator implementation in Zephyr OS, managing unicast streams, discovery, and audio data transmission.

methods.name: unicast_stream_configured
methods.description: Callback when a unicast stream is configured.

methods.name: unicast_stream_qos_set
methods.description: Callback when QoS is set for a stream.

methods.name: unicast_stream_enabled
methods.description: Callback when a stream is enabled.

methods.name: unicast_stream_started
methods.description: Callback when a stream starts, signals start via semaphore.

methods.name: unicast_stream_metadata_updated
methods.description: Callback when stream metadata is updated.

methods.name: unicast_stream_disabled
methods.description: Callback when a stream is disabled.

methods.name: unicast_stream_stopped
methods.description: Callback when a stream stops, cancels send timer.

methods.name: unicast_stream_released
methods.description: Callback when a stream is released.

methods.name: cap_discovery_complete_cb
methods.description: Callback when CAS discovery completes.

methods.name: unicast_start_complete_cb
methods.description: Callback when unicast start completes.

methods.name: unicast_update_complete_cb
methods.description: Callback when unicast update completes.

methods.name: unicast_stop_complete_cb
methods.description: Callback when unicast stop completes.

methods.name: discover_cas
methods.description: Performs CAS discovery over a connection.

methods.name: print_hex
methods.description: Prints hex representation of data.

methods.name: print_cb
methods.description: Callback to print bt_data content.

methods.name: print_remote_codec
methods.description: Prints details of remote codec capabilities.

methods.name: add_remote_sink
methods.description: Adds a remote sink endpoint to list.

methods.name: add_remote_source
methods.description: Adds a remote source endpoint to list.

methods.name: discover_cb
methods.description: Handles discovery completion for sink/source.

methods.name: pac_record_cb
methods.description: Records PAC info and prints codec details.

methods.name: endpoint_cb
methods.description: Handles endpoint discovery and adds endpoints.

methods.name: discover_sinks
methods.description: Discovers sink endpoints.

methods.name: discover_sources
methods.description: Discovers source endpoints.

methods.name: unicast_group_create
methods.description: Creates a unicast group for streams.

methods.name: unicast_audio_start
methods.description: Starts unicast audio streams.

methods.name: audio_timer_timeout
methods.description: Timer callback to send mock audio data periodically.

methods.name: cap_initiator_init
methods.description: Initializes the CAP initiator, registers callbacks, and stream ops.

methods.name: cap_initiator_setup
methods.description: Sets up connection, performs discovery, creates group, and starts audio.
